name: AirDeck
description: Turn your YouTube tabs into DJ decks. Mix songs, switch the bass and vocals on and off, and record. Runs entirely in your browser.

action.default_title: AirDeck: send this tab to a deck

send-to-deck-a.description: Send this YouTube tab to Deck A

send-to-deck-b.description: Send this YouTube tab to Deck B

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://i.ytimg.com; media-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'
